note: The Scrapyard gate and the Throne Room's dressing, first draft (23 Nov). The loot sheet's form. See README.md.

gate_front_shut.note: The Scrapyard gate, shut. Solid across the whole 48 px corridor. The corridor's floor runs from x = 4 to x = 51 in the frame: the posts stand 4 px into the rock each side. Origin = the middle of its bottom edge, on the ground.

gate_front_open.note: The same, open: each leaf swung back up the corridor against its post. The middle 32 px (x = 12 to 43 in the frame) is clear; the 8 px at each side stay solid.

gate_front_opening.note: Shut to open, 4 frames, not a loop: show gate_front_shut, these four, then gate_front_open.

scrap_heap_large.note: A heap of forge scrap for the Throne Room. Solid: about 40 wide and 8 deep. Origin = the middle of its front edge.

scrap_heap_small.note: A smaller heap. Solid: about 22 wide and 6 deep.

brazier.note: A standing brazier, a loop. Solid: about 10 wide and 4 deep. Use a pair, one each side of the throne; mirror one.
